control.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
control.benchmark_requirement: Systems must be scanned at the defined frequency, findings must be tracked, and vulnerabilities must be remediated or formally accepted within risk-based deadlines.

evidence.content: Internet-facing production systems are scanned weekly. Critical findings are remediated within 7 days and high findings within 30 days unless formally accepted.
